subject: gk
question: Correctly match the following. **Type of Industries** **Name of Company** i. Public sector
solution:
The correct answer is __**1 - b, 2 - a, 3 - c.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Public sector** companies are owned and operated by the government. **Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited (BHEL)** is a public sector company. Hence, 1 matches with b.
 
• **Private sector** companies are owned and operated by private individuals or groups. **Tata Iron and Steel Company** is a private sector company. Hence, 2 matches with a.
 
• **Joint sector** companies are operated by both government and private entities. **Oil India Ltd** is a joint sector company. Hence, 3 matches with c.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Public Sector:**__

 __
 
• These companies are owned and operated by the government.
 
• Examples include Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited (BHEL), Steel Authority of India Limited (SAIL), etc.
 
 
 
• **Private Sector:**__
 __
 
• These companies are owned and operated by private individuals or groups.
 
• Examples include Tata Iron and Steel Company, Reliance Industries, etc.
 
 
 
• **Joint Sector:**__
 
 
• These companies are operated by both government and private entities.
 
• Examples include Oil India Ltd, Maruti Suzuki India Ltd, etc.
